An /agent run is a durable flow run readable only by the person who started it, from a conversation whose own authority (Social chatAccess with PostMessage, or a tenant family / huddle chat publish) still admits them. Starting one plans a goal (no step runs); Approve and Discard are once-only claims on that plan, an approval step pauses the loop and its approve/reject are once-only decisions by the requester (or, where the tenant's second-approver rule allows, another editor), and Approve then starts the existing summarize, deck, diagram and doc flows as that person's freshly reloaded session. The capture holds neither a run nor a conversation seat, and the loop outlives the request; isolated route tests (agent-loop-social.test.ts, agent-loop-tenant.test.ts, lib/agent-loop) and the headless spec cover these writes.
